name: How long does a kitchen countertop replacement take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen countertop replacement take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most countertop installations take one to two days on site, but the entire process typically spans one to three weeks. After you select your material, technicians create an exact laser template of your existing cabinetry. Custom fabrication at the stone shop takes roughly one to two weeks depending on the slab. On installation day, crews remove old counters, set the new slabs, join seams, cut holes for fixtures, and mount your sink. Plumbing reconnections are usually scheduled for the following day to allow adhesives and silicone to cure properly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fabrication takes one to two weeks following templating, while the actual removal and installation in your home usually takes one to two days.
